issues.title: Make flaky-page detection threshold configurable
issues.body:
The memory subsystem hard-codes the threshold for marking a page as flaky.

Expose it through the Zod config schema so runs can tune sensitivity per target.

- [ ] Add config field with a sensible default
- [ ] Thread it into the flaky-page tracker
- [ ] Cover with a unit test

issues.title: Document rate-limit guidance for adversarial workers
issues.body:
Adversarial workers can issue bursts of requests during injection and race-condition probes.

Add docs describing how to throttle them safely against shared or production-like targets.
